name: Baja 1000 style: Ojos Negros - Valle de Trinidad - Mike's Sky Rancho
region: Ensenada / San Quintin, Baja California, Mexico
author: Rally Raid samples
description: Patterned after the SCORE Baja 1000 / Baja 500 northern loop: graded dirt out of Ojos Negros, a 40 km/h zone in the village, Valle de la Trinidad, then the mountain road to Mike's Sky Rancho. Baja races use mandatory virtual checkpoints: modelled here with WPV and WPC (no hidden waypoints, Baja is about speed, not navigation). Countdown start like a Baja start line.
